description: This file contains handlers and utilities for processing LINE messaging platform webhook events, including message handling, event filtering, media download, and replay protection.

classes.name: LineWebhookReplayCache
classes.description: Cache structure for managing replay protection of webhook events.

classes.name: LineHandlerContext
classes.description: Context object passed to event handlers containing configuration, account info, runtime, and processing functions.

methods.name: createLineWebhookReplayCache
methods.description: Initializes a new replay cache for webhook event deduplication.

methods.name: pruneLineWebhookReplayCache
methods.description: Removes old entries from the replay cache based on time and size limits.

methods.name: buildLineWebhookReplayKey
methods.description: Generates a unique key for replay protection based on event type and source.

methods.name: getLineReplayCandidate
methods.description: Retrieves a replay candidate if the event is eligible for replay protection.

methods.name: shouldSkipLineReplayEvent
methods.description: Determines if an event should be skipped due to being a duplicate or in-flight.

methods.name: markLineReplayEventInFlight
methods.description: Marks an event as in-flight to prevent duplicate processing.

methods.name: clearLineReplayEventInFlight
methods.description: Removes an event from in-flight tracking after processing.

methods.name: rememberLineReplayEvent
methods.description: Records an event as seen to prevent reprocessing.

methods.name: resolveLineGroupConfig
methods.description: Resolves group configuration based on group or room ID.

methods.name: sendLinePairingReply
methods.description: Sends a pairing challenge reply to a LINE user.

methods.name: shouldProcessLineEvent
methods.description: Determines if an event is allowed to be processed based on permissions and policies.

methods.name: getLineMentionees
methods.description: Extracts mentionees from a message.

methods.name: isLineBotMentioned
methods.description: Checks if the bot is mentioned in a message.

methods.name: hasAnyLineMention
methods.description: Checks if there are any mentions in a message.

methods.name: resolveEventRawText
methods.description: Extracts raw text content from message or postback events.

methods.name: resolveLineCommandAuthorized
methods.description: Determines if a command is authorized based on sender and configuration.

methods.name: handleMessageEvent
methods.description: Processes incoming message events, including media download and mention handling.

methods.name: handleFollowEvent
methods.description: Handles user follow events.

methods.name: handleUnfollowEvent
methods.description: Handles user unfollow events.

methods.name: handleJoinEvent
methods.description: Handles bot join events to groups or rooms.

methods.name: handleLeaveEvent
methods.description: Handles bot leave events from groups or rooms.

methods.name: handlePostbackEvent
methods.description: Processes postback events.

methods.name: handleLineWebhookEvents
methods.description: Main entry point for processing a batch of webhook events with replay protection.
